checks.name: native route/schema bindings boot and M3 health identifies browser integration
standard SDK publishable key remains bound to the verified Host
public product pricing and region lookups never return the sibling store
draft products and disabled channels are absent from the public store
Host-bound SQL sessions tolerate DNS case, ports and trailing dot but reject another store
browser mutations require the exact store origin even between sibling subdomains
public media and theme settings are tenant-scoped with an explicit safe DTO
nested variants enforce their parent and reusable options remain tenant-scoped
single warehouse, native stock adjustments and links reject foreign endpoints before writes
native inventory grid batches validate every tenant and leave no partial stock changes
actual native Admin list and option form selectors stay inside the reviewed DTOs
public categories remove internal and inactive children and private metadata
existing tenant M3 configuration is idempotent and preserves saved branding
same customer email creates independent tenant identities and profiles
address CRUD enforces the customer as well as the tenant
native carts, quantity edits and deletion keep customer ownership and server prices
shipping choices, system test payments and order completion use native workflows for both stores
order lists, details and Admin queries reject cross-store and same-store customer access
unreviewed Admin and public operations stay closed at the gateway
